title: Cech vanishing on a basis with a cofinal set of coverings gives cohomology vanishing (Stacks 01EW, for O_X-modules on a scheme)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ let $\mathcal F|_U$ be the restricted $\mathcal O_U$-module, $(\mathcal F|_U)(W)=\mathcal F(W)$ for $W\subseteq U$ open [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], and $H^p(U,-)$ the cohomology of the scheme $U$ (an open subscheme of $X$), the right derived functors of $\Gamma(U,-)$ on $\mathcal O_U$-modules [pqf-def-cohomology]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ and a family $(U_j)_{j\in J}$ of opens with $U=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ let $\mathcal U=\{U_j\to U\}_{j\in J}$ be the corresponding covering of the Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$ (the site of open subschemes of $X$ with inclusions as morphisms and jointly surjective open families as coverings [def-sc-zariski-site]; the fibre product $U_{j_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{j_p}$ is the intersection $U_{j_0\ldots j_p}=U_{j_0}\cap\cdots\cap U_{j_p}$), and let $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ be the Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of the underlying presheaf of abelian groups $W\mapsto\mathcal F(W)$ for $\mathcal U$ (degree $p$ term $\prod_{(j_0,\ldots,j_p)\in J^{p+1}}\mathcal F(U_{j_0\ldots j_p})$, alternating sum of restrictions as differential). Let $\mathcal B$ be a set of open subsets of $X$ which is a basis of the topology, and $\mathrm{Cov}$ a set of such coverings, such that: (1) for every $\mathcal U:U=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ in $\mathrm{Cov}$, $U$, every $U_j$ and every $U_{j_0\ldots j_p}$ ($p\ge0$, $j_k\in J$) lie in $\mathcal B$; (2) for every $U\in\mathcal B$ the coverings of $U$ occurring in $\mathrm{Cov}$ are cofinal among all open coverings of $U$: every open covering $U=\bigcup_aV_a$ is refined by some $U=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ in $\mathrm{Cov}$, i.e. every $U_j$ lies in some $V_a$; (3) $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)=0$ for every $\mathcal U\in\mathrm{Cov}$ and every $p>0$. Then $H^p(U,\mathcal F|_U)=0$ for every $p>0$ and every $U\in\mathcal B$. (Stacks states this for ringed spaces, with $H^p(U,\mathcal F)$ the derived functors of $\Gamma(U,-)$ on $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, which equal $H^p(U,\mathcal F|_U)$ by Lemma 01E1; it is the variant of [lem-weil-pbc-module-cech-vanishing-criterion] (Stacks 01EV) in which only the opens of $\mathcal B$ and the coverings in $\mathrm{Cov}$ occur.)
